subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should OpenClaw make cross-session memory continuity a supported default with defined privacy and retention rules, or keep it opt-in while metrics and restart preload are designed as separate initiatives?
rationale: The remaining work adds user-facing capabilities and likely configuration/default surfaces across session data, search scope, and startup lifecycle; source context shows partial implementation but cannot select the permanent product contract.

options.title: Split and sponsor narrow work
options.body: Create or adopt separate canonical issues for session-memory graduation, agent metrics, and restart preload, each with explicit privacy and upgrade contracts.

options.title: Retain the umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue as the planning umbrella while maintainers define one coordinated memory roadmap before implementation.

options.title: Keep experimental scope
options.body: Leave existing semantic and session-memory facilities opt-in and defer new metrics and preload behavior until a later product cycle.

recommendation.title: Split and sponsor narrow work
recommendation.body: Create or adopt separate canonical issues for session-memory graduation, agent metrics, and restart preload, each with explicit privacy and upgrade contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied feature-history review connects this person to the central memory search, usage observability, and startup-memory surfaces.
